best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult lobula plate columnar neuron LPC1 (Özel et al., 2021).

justification: 'LPC1' is FBbt:00111767 'lobula plate columnar neuron LPC1'; at P15-P40 the cells are developing (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage), so its immature form FBbt:00053679 (FBbt #2219, release 2026-11-02).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that develops from an optic neuroblast and will become an adult optic lobe neuron.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent of the new immature LPC1 term (used until FBbt #2219 was released).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Lobula plate columnar neuron that has its main dendritic arborization in lobula plate layer 2 and receives input from T4b and T5b neurons (Shinomiya et al., 2022). It projects to a small glomerulus in the posterior region of the optic glomeruli of the PVLP, posterior to LC4 and ventral to LPLC3. It is cholinergic (Davis et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form, used from the pharate adult stage; no immature form in FBbt.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053679 'immature lobula plate columnar neuron LPC1' (exact match).
